external_standard.name: JSON Schema Draft 2020-12
external_standard.selection: Draft 2020-12 is explicitly declared by every v1 schema document; the source defines JSON Schema core mechanisms including dialect selection, schema identifiers, references, and reusable definitions.

checks.name: structural schema contract
checks.details: The shared library and all 16 expected entry schemas declared Draft 2020-12, referenced the correct shared definition, required schema_version and an identifier property, and rejected unspecified v1 fields.

checks.name: JSON document parsing
